fields.informations_diverses: Vellum, 16th century codex; 15.2 x 14cm; 222 folios; full binding; wooden board covers; fols. 5-196 single columns and the rest double; 16 lines per column; Ms. generally in good and legible condition, but slightly soiled throughout.
fields.contenu:
Title: The Psalter. 1) fols. 5-168b The Psalms. 2) fols. 169a-186a: The Songs of the Prop-hets (i.e. Ecclesiastical Canticles). The “nine and six” morning odes and pra-yers (as they are called in this manuscript), with their respective rubrics. 3) fols. 186a-196a: The Song of Songs. 4) fols. 197a-217b: Weddasse Maryam to-gether with Porch of Light.
Additional Content. 1) fols. 1b-2b and 4. A theological allegorical treatise: the Church means a reservoir, the Ark means Christ, etc., in Amharic. 2) fol. 196a. A story of a miracle of Mary (a different pen). 3) fols. 217b-218a.- A short salam to Gabra-Manfas Geddus. 4) fols. 218b-219a. A story about the sorrows of Mary. 5) fols. 219a-220a. “Be glad”.- a song to Mary (different pen). 6) fols. 3 and 220b-221b. Another short prayer to Mary. 7) fol. 222a-b. Trial of the pen.
